offers_products.reason: Main offerings are care services at nursing centers, assisted living and hospitals; pharmacy is incidental.

offers_services.reason: Skilled nursing, assisted living, memory care, home care, hospice, rehabilitation and geriatric psychiatric care.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients and residents (seniors) and their families choose and receive the nursing and living care.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Care is chosen and received by individual patients and residents, not by businesses or agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Residents stay long-term in nursing and assisted living, and home care and hospice are ongoing, so revenue is daily and recurring.

cyclical_demand.reason: Senior nursing, memory care and hospice are needed medical care that is hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay daily or monthly care charges rather than one large purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Nursing and caregiver staff time and skill is what residents pay for, though facilities support it.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual seniors and families, even though Medicare and Medicaid pay much of the cost.

asset_heavy.reason: It runs many owned nursing centers, assisted living communities and psychiatric hospitals that need ongoing property investment.

notes: People-delivered is borderline because care is staff-driven but relies on owned facilities.
